description:
£150 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the student lettings market this spacious four-bedroom maisonette on Osborne Road, Jesmond.

Ideally situated near Lyndhurst Avenue in West Jesmond, the property is perfectly suited to students looking for generous living space in a convenient location, with West Jesmond Metro Station and Jesmond-s popular local amenities just a short walk away.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hall with stairs leading to the first floor, a large kitchen, a modern bathroom and a spacious central living room, providing an ideal space for relaxing and socialising. The property also benefits from four double bedrooms spread across two floors, offering plenty of room for a group of students.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
